---
title: "coagglomeration -- OC 2022-NOV"
output: html_notebook
---

developed by sandorjuhasz

### coagglomeration

3 distinct version prepared <br>
-- all 3-digit NACE industries <br>
-- only manufacturing 3-digit NACE industries <br>
-- only MNEs in all 3-digit NACE industries <br>

all 3 distinct versions are prepared for 3 region types <br>
-- megye (NUTS 3) <br>
-- jaras (LAU 1) <br>
-- urban agglomeration (20) <br>

![__megye -- NUTS 3__](../figures/megye_illustration.png)

![__jaras -- micro regions__](../figures/jaras_illustration.png)

![__agglom__](../figures/agglom_illustration.png)



```{r, echo=FALSE, results=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source("../scripts/02_coagglomeration_exploration_functions.R")
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
library(mefa4)
library(ggplot2)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(stargazer)

# parameters
region <- c("megye", "jaras", "agglom")
industry <- "nace3d"
colors <- c("#e9c46a", "#264653")
```


### transactions

for simplification -- at this point -- I only use A -- bought from -- B ties <br>
<br>
agglom(erations) do not cover the country fully -- transactions are only between industries inside or in between urban agglomeration

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# list of different data versions
tr_data <- list()
for(v in 1:length(region))
{
  tr_data[[v]] <- fread(
    paste0(
      "../data/oc_2022_november/transactions_indreg_",
      industry,
      "_",
      region[v],
      ".csv"
    )
  )
}

# aggregate to industry-industry level
group_cols <- c("nace3d1", "nace3d2")
indind_tr <- list()
for(t in 1:length(tr_data)){
  indind_tr[[t]] <- ind_ind_aggregation(tr_data[[t]], group_cols, weight_col = "tb_count", weight_min = 1)
}

# distribution plots
p1 <- ggplot(data.frame(indind_tr[[1]]), aes(x = tb_count)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30, , color="black", fill=colors[1]) +
  ggtitle(region[1]) +
  xlab("Nr transactions (buy)") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))) +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=10), axis.title=element_text(size=15))

p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(indind_tr[[2]]), aes(x = tb_count)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30, , color="black", fill=colors[1]) +
  ggtitle(region[2]) +
  xlab("Nr transactions (buy)") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))) +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=10), axis.title=element_text(size=15))

p3 <- ggplot(data.frame(indind_tr[[3]]), aes(x = tb_count)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30, , color="black", fill=colors[1]) +
  ggtitle(region[3]) +
  xlab("Nr transactions (buy)") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))) +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=10), axis.title=element_text(size=15))

(p1 + p2 + p3)
```




### skill relatedness

as I still dont have the raw data on labor flow between industry regions, I use skill relatedness


```{r}
# transform Lorincz et al skill relatedness data to 3-digit average values
sr <- fread("../data/relatedness/SR_avg.csv")
sr_df <- sr_transformation(sr)

# distribution plots

```

```{r, echo=FAlSE}
# combine different coagglomeration - transactions - skill relatedness
indind_tables <- list()
for(v in 1:length(region))
{
  # ADD transaction
  indind_tables[[v]] <- merge(
      coagg_data[[v]],
      indind_tr[[v]],
      by.x = c("ind1", "ind2"),
      by.y = c("nace3d1", "nace3d2"),
      all.x = TRUE,
      all.y = FALSE
  )
  
  # log10 number of buy transactions 
  indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count_log <- ifelse(indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count > 1, round(log10(indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count), 3), 0)
  indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count_log[is.na(indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count_log)==1] <- 0
  
  # ADD skill relatedness
  indind_tables[[v]] <- merge(
    indind_tables[[v]],
    sr_df,
    by.x = c("ind1", "ind2"),
    by.y = c("nace3d1", "nace3d2"),
    all.x = TRUE,
    all.y = FALSE
  )
  indind_tables[[v]]$sr_avg[is.na(indind_tables[[v]]$sr_avg)==1] <- 0
  indind_tables[[v]]$rel01[is.na(indind_tables[[v]]$rel01)==1] <- 0
  
  # nr firms for control
  indind_tables[[v]]$nr_firms1_log <- log10(indind_tables[[v]]$nr_firms1)
  indind_tables[[v]]$nr_firms2_log <- log10(indind_tables[[v]]$nr_firms2)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}

model_save <- function(df, file_name)
{
  m1 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ tb_count_log, data = df)
  m2 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ sr_avg, data = df)
  m3 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ tb_count_log + sr_avg, data = df)
  m4 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ tb_count_log + sr_avg + nr_firms1_log + nr_firms2_log, data = df)

  stargazer(m1, m2, m3, m4, out=file_name)
}

model_save(indind_tables[[1]], file_name = paste0("../outputs/baseline_coagglom_models_", region[1], ".html"))
model_save(indind_tables[[2]], file_name = paste0("../outputs/baseline_coagglom_models_", region[2], ".html"))
model_save(indind_tables[[3]], file_name = paste0("../outputs/baseline_coagglom_models_", region[3], ".html"))

```

```{r, echo=FAlSE}
  # log10 number of buy transactions 
  indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count_log <- ifelse(indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count > 1, round(log10(indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count), 3), 0)
  indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count_log[is.na(indind_tables[[v]]$tb_count_log)==1] <- 0
  
  # ADD skill relatedness
  indind_tables[[v]] <- merge(
    indind_tables[[v]],
    sr_df,
    by.x = c("ind1", "ind2"),
    by.y = c("nace3d1", "nace3d2"),
    all.x = TRUE,
    all.y = FALSE
  )
  indind_tables[[v]]$sr_avg[is.na(indind_tables[[v]]$sr_avg)==1] <- 0
  indind_tables[[v]]$rel01[is.na(indind_tables[[v]]$rel01)==1] <- 0
  
  # nr firms for control
  indind_tables[[v]]$nr_mnes1_log <- log10(indind_tables[[v]]$nr_mnes1)
  indind_tables[[v]]$nr_mnes2_log <- log10(indind_tables[[v]]$nr_mnes2)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}

model_save_mnes <- function(df, file_name)
{
  m1 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ tb_count_log, data = df)
  m2 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ sr_avg, data = df)
  m3 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ tb_count_log + sr_avg, data = df)
  m4 <- lm(coagglomeration ~ tb_count_log + sr_avg + nr_mnes1_log + nr_mnes2_log, data = df)

  stargazer(m1, m2, m3, m4, out=file_name)
}

model_save_mnes(indind_tables[[1]], file_name = paste0("../outputs/baseline_coagglom_mnes_models_", region[1], ".html"))
model_save_mnes(indind_tables[[2]], file_name = paste0("../outputs/baseline_coagglom_mnes_models_", region[2], ".html"))
model_save_mnes(indind_tables[[3]], file_name = paste0("../outputs/baseline_coagglom_mnes_models_", region[3], ".html"))
```

### network approach


```{r}
# networks of industry regions
tr_data[[1]]$indreg1 <- paste0(tr_data[[1]]$nace3d1, "-", tr_data[[1]]$megye_kod1)
tr_data[[1]]$indreg2 <- paste0(tr_data[[1]]$nace3d2, "-", tr_data[[1]]$megye_kod2)

tr_data[[2]]$indreg1 <- paste0(tr_data[[2]]$nace3d1, "-", tr_data[[2]]$jaras_kod1)
tr_data[[2]]$indreg2 <- paste0(tr_data[[2]]$nace3d2, "-", tr_data[[2]]$jaras_kod2)

tr_data[[3]]$indreg1 <- paste0(tr_data[[3]]$nace3d1, "-", tr_data[[3]]$agglom_id1)
tr_data[[3]]$indreg2 <- paste0(tr_data[[3]]$nace3d2, "-", tr_data[[3]]$agglom_id2)


tr_graph <- list()
tr_central <- list()
for(g in 1:length(region))
{
  tr_graph[[g]] <- create_transaction_network(tr_data[[g]], weight = "tb_count")
  tr_central[[g]] <- data.table(V(tr_graph[[g]])$name,
                                degree(tr_graph[[g]]),
                                degree(tr_graph[[g]], mode = "in"),
                                degree(tr_graph[[g]], mode = "out"))
  colnames(tr_central[[g]]) <- c("indreg", "degree", "nr_buyer_ties", "nr_supplier_ties")
}



```


### growth models

```{r}
# growth models on industry region level -- baseline model
gr_df <- fread(paste0("../data/oc_2022_november/indreg_2018_2020_", region[1], ".csv"))
gr_df$log_growth_rate <- log10(gr_df$total_emp20 / gr_df$total_emp18)
gr_df$log_total_emp18 <- log10(gr_df$total_emp18)
gr_df$log_nr_firms18 <- log10(gr_df$nr_firms18)

summary(lm(log_growth_rate ~ rca18 + emp_max_hozz18 + log_nr_firms18 + log_total_emp18, data = gr_df))
```
